prerequisites: No prerequisites. Competencies taught in advanced modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have advanced in-depth knowledge and skills in a selected specialized area of computer science
can report on current research results and handle research literature

can apply computer science methods to the selected specialized area of computer science (developing and applying fundamental solution strategies and their formal description, training abstraction skills, system development)
are able to apply scientific working methods to independently solve problems and communicate the solution
have acquired competencies preferably in the area of Practical Computer Science

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50% of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two of the exercise assignments. The examination performance is a written exam or an individual oral examination. Grading is on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
